governance.architecture_and_history: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited, formerly Bajaj Corp Limited, was incorporated in 2006 and is part of the diversified Bajaj Group. The company is primarily a hair oil manufacturer with a smaller presence in skincare. Its flagship brand, Bajaj Almond Drops Hair Oil (ADHO), launched in 1989, is a key revenue driver. The company has undergone a name change to Bajaj Consumer Care Limited, with Dhrashti Dhami appointed as Brand Ambassador, signaling a renewed focus on brand building. The company operates in the FMCG sector, with its headquarters in Udaipur, Rajasthan. It has a significant presence in domestic and international markets, utilizing a distribution network that includes regional offices, carrying and forwarding agents, and distributors. The company has nine production facilities, including third-party operations, located across Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Guwahati for hair and skincare products, and one facility in Udaipur for oral care products. The company's history traces back to products sold by different Bajaj group companies since 1953, with Bajaj Sevashram (BSL) manufacturing and selling products until December 2000. In January 2001, Deccan Ayurvedashram Pharmacy Ltd (which later became Bajaj Consumer Care Ltd) acquired the operating business and trademarks. A brand licensing agreement with the promoter BCCL was entered into on March 12, 2008. The company's market capitalization as of May 8, 2026, was ₹71.33 billion, showing a significant increase of 187.25% in one year.
